upright: The Page of Pentacles heralds a time of new beginnings, practical opportunities, and the desire to learn. You are starting a new project, study, or business venture with enthusiasm and a grounded mindset. This card encourages you to remain focused, develop your skills, and take practical, step-by-step actions to turn your dreams into reality.
reversed: Reversed, this card suggests a lack of focus, procrastination, or missed opportunities due to poor planning. You may find yourself dreaming without taking action, or feeling overwhelmed by the practical details of a project. It is a call to ground yourself, eliminate distractions, and commit to the hard work required for success.
symbolism: The Page stands in a lush, plowed field under a clear yellow sky, symbolizing fertile ground ready for planting seeds of ambition. He wears green and brown garments, reflecting his deep connection to the earth and practical matters. The single pentacle is held delicately in both hands, balanced as if he is carefully studying its worth and potential, while the distant mountains represent the long-term goals he aims to achieve.
love: In love, this card represents a fresh, practical start or a relationship based on shared goals and learning. You and your partner may be planning your future together. If single, you are open to meeting someone grounded and dependable, or you are focusing on self-improvement before entering a relationship.
career: You are entering a phase of skill development, training, or starting a new career path. A new job offer, business idea, or educational opportunity is presenting itself. Success will come through diligence, careful study, and applying yourself to the practical details of your work.

name: Knight of Pentacles
description: A sturdy knight sits atop a heavy black horse, surveying a vast, plowed field. He holds a single golden pentacle in his hand, looking forward with quiet determination. Unlike the other knights, he is stationary, representing patience, methodical progress, and unwavering commitment to his duties.
upright: The Knight of Pentacles represents reliability, hard work, and methodical progress. You are dedicated to your goals, willing to put in the effort, and patient enough to wait for results. This card encourages you to remain steadfast, follow your routines, and execute your plans with careful attention to detail, ensuring long-term success.
reversed: Reversed, this card warns of stagnation, boredom, or becoming overly stubborn and resistant to change. You may feel stuck in a rut, procrastinating, or neglecting your responsibilities. It is a reminder to break free from monotonous routines, inject some spontaneity into your life, and find new motivation to move forward.
symbolism: The Knight's heavy black workhorse stands firmly on the ground with all four hooves planted, representing endurance, stability, and a refusal to rush. He wears dark armor and a helmet adorned with green oak leaves, symbolizing growth and a deep connection to nature. The vast, freshly plowed fields stretching to the horizon behind him represent the slow, deliberate preparation and hard physical labor required to cultivate a bountiful harvest over time.
love: This card indicates a stable, loyal, and deeply committed relationship. Your partner is dependable, though perhaps not overly romantic or spontaneous. If single, you are looking for a secure, long-term partnership built on trust and shared values rather than fleeting excitement, and you are willing to take things slow.
career: Your career progress is steady and reliable. You are recognized for your strong work ethic, attention to detail, and ability to complete complex projects. It is a time to focus on routine, fulfill your duties diligently, and build a secure professional reputation through consistent, high-quality performance.

name: Queen of Pentacles
description: A warm, maternal queen sits on a beautifully carved stone throne in a lush, blooming garden. She cradles a large golden pentacle in her lap, looking down at it with loving care. Around her, nature flourishes, symbolizing her ability to nurture both her family and her material prosperity.
upright: The Queen of Pentacles embodies nurturing energy, practicality, and material abundance. You are able to balance your professional ambitions with a warm, welcoming home life. This card encourages you to care for others, manage your resources wisely, and create a secure, comfortable environment where both your family and your creative projects can thrive.
reversed: Reversed, this card suggests a work-life imbalance, self-neglect, or becoming overly materialistic and possessive. You may be smothering others with your care, or conversely, neglecting your home and family in pursuit of career goals. It is a call to restore balance, practice self-care, and reconnect with your nurturing nature.
symbolism: The Queen's throne is carved with images of goats, angels, and fruit, representing fertility, earth energy, and spiritual protection. A small rabbit leaps in the lower right corner, symbolizing abundance, fertility, and quick-wittedness. Above her, a canopy of red roses frames the scene, while the lush green landscape and flowing stream behind her emphasize her deep connection to nature's vital life force.
love: In love, this card represents a warm, stable, and nurturing relationship. You and your partner support each other's growth and enjoy creating a comfortable home together. If single, you are attracting potential partners with your grounded, caring, and self-assured nature, ready for a secure and loving partnership.
career: You are highly successful in managing your career and financial resources. You excel in roles that require organization, nurturing others, or managing practical details. Your ability to maintain a healthy work-life balance is a key factor in your professional success and overall happiness.

name: King of Pentacles
description: A powerful, mature king sits on a throne adorned with carved bulls, surrounded by vines, flowers, and the stone walls of his castle. He holds a scepter in one hand and rests the other on a large golden pentacle, embodying supreme material mastery, security, and worldly success.
upright: The King of Pentacles represents the ultimate mastery of the material world, financial security, and strong leadership. You have achieved success through discipline, hard work, and practical wisdom. This card encourages you to be a reliable provider, manage your wealth responsibly, and use your influence to support and protect those around you.
reversed: Reversed, this card warns of greed, corruption, or a rigid, stubborn attitude. You may be focusing too much on material wealth at the expense of your relationships, or experiencing financial losses due to poor judgment. It is a reminder to avoid unethical behavior, manage your resources more wisely, and reconnect with your core values to rebuild your stability.
symbolism: The King's throne is decorated with carved bull heads, representing the astrological sign of Taurus and steadfast determination. His robe is embroidered with ripe grapevines, symbolizing his abundant wealth and achievements. He rests his foot on a carved stone block, showing his power over the earth, while his massive castle stands behind him, representing enduring security and established power.
love: In love, this card signifies a deeply stable, protective, and committed relationship. Your partner is a reliable provider who shows love through practical actions and security. If single, you are ready for a mature, long-term relationship with someone who is financially secure, grounded, and ready to build a life with you.
career: Your career is at its peak, and you are recognized as a leader or expert in your field. You have achieved financial security and business success through discipline and wise decision-making. It is an excellent time to mentor others, invest in long-term projects, and enjoy your professional achievements.
